INSERT INTO job_events (
            job_id,
            run_number,
            attempt,
            event_type,
            stage,
            payload
         )
         SELECT id,
                run_number,
                attempt,
                'LEASED',
                stage,
                jsonb_build_object('worker_id', $2::text, 'lease_duration_seconds', $3::int4)
         FROM job_queue
         WHERE id = ANY($1::uuid[])
